system.description:
-- Only for Humanoid Biomorphs --

Even though sculpted good looks are easily purchased, this morph is conspicuously ugly or poorly designed, inspiring distaste or even revulsion in others. Apply a –10 modifier to Persuade and Provoke Tests where your hideousness may be a factor. Level 1 of this trait only applies to uplifts and synthmorphs; Level 2 is for
humanoid biomorphs.
